title: Chapter 6756: Black Dragon Bloodline

Chapter 6756: Black Dragon Bloodline

Chapter 6756: Black Dragon Bloodline

“Boom!” Black flames surged from the concentrated hole, seemingly wanting to leave the body. It caused incredible agony to the girl; her father couldn’t bear to watch.

“Bam!” A visual phenomenon emerged from the black flames wanting to leave - a baby with no eyes. On its forehead was a dark blot resembling a black hole, always shifting unstably.

She gave the feeling of being a cosmo capable of devouring anything. This was due to the black hole; she herself had no such wishes.

Xiaoyue continued to suppress the black hole from leaving with her immortal power. The terrible bloodline within stood no chance, given the disparity in cultivation.

The girl shuddered once her hidden power was forced inside again and fell to the ground.

“My daughter!” The lord cried out.

“Don’t touch her, she’s fine and will wake up on her own.” Li Qiye said.

The lord stopped trying to pick her up and said softly: “Immortal, what’s wrong with her?”

“Nothing, just watch.” Li Qiye said.

Xiaoyue returned to his side and asked: “Young Noble, what do you think?”

“The bloodline manifested clearly, you know it better than I do.” Li Qiye said.

“Gluttonous beast, but it seems different from a pure-blooded gluttonous beast.” She said.

“How so?” He asked.

She only sighed in response.

“So you do know. No secrets can be kept forever. For example, whatever happened with the phoenix in Divine Firmament.” He remarked.

“They should stay as secrets.” She said.

“I don’t always find rumors and secrets interesting. But, I have looked into this bloodline.” He said.

“What did you find, Young Noble?” She asked.

“Divine Firmament believes they have the purest and oldest bloodlines, unaware of other main branches outside, the blood of kings.” He said: “Such a case is before you.”

“Her bloodline isn’t pure.” She shook her head while staring at the girl.

“Yes.” He said.

“Then are you talking about the black dragon?” Her expression changed.

“Do you believe he possesses a pure bloodline?” He asked.

“No.” She said.

“It’s because you’re thinking about this incorrectly. It’s not limited to pure and original bloodlines.” He said.

“The bloodlines of kings...” She staggered one step backward.

“Now you’re getting there.” He said.

“I find it inconceivable.” She stared at him.

“This world has ways to surprise people.” He said.

“Was it you who forged it, Young Noble?” She couldn’t help but ask.

“Don’t look at me like that, I don’t have the pure bloodlines or the king bloodlines. Where would I go to create it? I’m not a deviant.” He said: “But even if I were a deviant, I wouldn’t be interested in something so limited. I am not a divine beast, so why would I care about their bloodline? The human’s bloodline is perfectly fine. Weak initially with a low floor but an unlimited ceiling.”

“And the black dragon?” She asked again.

“Just a black dragon, nothing more.” He said: “Not necessarily a pureblooded dragon or one with the king bloodline. Of course, this might change when the time comes.”

“You mentioned there are other places, not just Divine Firmament. Where are they?” She asked.

“How do I know? Talk to the divine beasts there to see if they have forgotten something.” He said.

“Perhaps I must visit a few places.” She murmured upon coming up with a new idea.

“Noticing some peculiarities?” He asked.

“Yes, Young Noble. The answer might not be in Heaven Realm at all.” She said.

“It is unwise to be stubborn. If I don’t allow it, the consequences are severe, that is all I will say on this matter.” He glanced at her and said.

She took a deep breath and understood the warning. Once he turned against her, she would be utterly obliterated, and that would only be the start of the disaster.

“I understand, I will not do anything without your approval.” She bowed.

“Good, there are places that are better off without immortals, especially one such as yourself.” He said.

“I will not forget.” She solemnly nodded.
